offending_extra_words: subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements
reasons: Preferred level is incomplete: the mandatory 30-day Customer Data return runs from "Customer's request" rather than from expiry or termination, so a request condition swallows the post-termination return (and, with it, the "thereafter" deletion and certification mechanic).
Format wording is "commonly used, machine-readable" rather than the playbook's "standard machine-readable"; substantively equivalent but worth conforming to the position wording.

Not minimal: the insert adds a broad new carve-out ("subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements") that dilutes the deletion duty, and extends the trigger to termination of "any Order Form", which is broader than needed and could disrupt continuing Services under other Order Forms.
Fix: change (b) to "within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination", limit the trigger to expiry or termination of this Agreement, and drop or narrow the backup/retention exception.
